description:
FILED s470 (Fable, 2026-09-05, evening) at the USER's word: "Add to the task queue that this (along with some implementation specifics) needs to be documented for users, too."

WHAT: a user-facing page on PCL's caches â what is cached, where, what keys it, when it is stale, and how to clear or disable it â written for someone running `pcl` on their own programs and CPAN modules, not for a compiler developer.  Today the README says only "the first run takes a few seconds longer: PCL compiles its runtime library once and caches the result under ~/.pcl-cache/", and the rest is in docs/test-infrastructure.md, docs/xs-artifact-cache.md, CLAUDE.md and the runtime's docstrings â developer records, not a user page.

WHERE: a new `docs/caching.md` (linked from README's quick-start paragraph and from docs/STATUS.md), plus the README paragraph corrected to say what is actually cached.

CONTENTS (each a measured fact, cite the mechanism):
 1. The SAVED CORE (`~/.pcl-cache/core/`): the compiled runtime, keyed by the runtime source hash + `sbcl --version` + ~/.sbclrc + the runtime's path; rebuilt on first use after any of those change; `PCL_NO_CORE=1` runs from source; a failed build leaves `<core>.failed` for an hour and falls back LOUDLY.
 2. The MODULE CACHE: every `use`d/`require`d module is transpiled ONCE to `~/.pcl-cache/<hash>.lisp` (key = the module's absolute path + the cache generation) and, since #1188, compiled once to a FASL (key adds the runtime hash + SBCL identity); validity = the module's own mtime (+ the dependency manifest once #1261 lands).  What that means for the user: editing a module re-transpiles it; editing a module that ANOTHER cached module `use`s does NOT re-transpile the dependent until #1261 â say so plainly, with `pcl --clear-cache` as the remedy; a CPAN upgrade is the same case.  The trust-class policy (#1261: fasls only for installed @INC modules) once it exists; `PCL_NO_FASL_CACHE=1`.
 3. STRING EVAL: `eval "â¦"` spawns the Perl-based compiler (`pl2cl --server`) once per program that evals and caches each string in-process (#1200 would make that a disk cache) â so a program that evals pays ~0.3 s once, and perl must be installed for it (the README already says this â link it).
 4. THE THREE CHECKED-IN ARTIFACTS (pack/mro/warnings) load from the tree (the extension load, #1202: today recompiled per run â state the cost honestly until it is fixed).
 5. Measured numbers, dated: startup ~0.17 s; `use Moo` / `use JSON::PP` warm and cold before and after #1188 (BN's and BP's tables); what `--clear-cache` costs to rebuild.
 6. The knobs in one table: `pcl --clear-cache`, `PCL_NO_CORE`, `PCL_NO_FASL_CACHE`, `PCL_SHOW_SBCL`, `PCL_OPT` (pointer to the optimisation registry paragraph), the cache directory override if one exists (check; if none, say so).
 7. Multi-user / CI notes: the cache is per HOME; a worktree gets its own core; two checkouts on the same generation string share the module cache (#1119) â tell users not to run two different PCL versions against one HOME concurrently until #1119 closes.

BAR: every sentence traceable to code or a measurement (cite the runtime function or the session record); the README/STATUS links resolve (`Pl/t/no-hardcoded-paths-01.t` and the link checker used for the README rewrite); reviewed by Fable as a user would read it.  Blocked on #1188 (the fasl facts) and written alongside #1261 so the staleness rules are stated once, correctly.  Prose agent (Sonnet is fine for the writing; the facts come from BP's and BN's records and a re-measurement).

=== DONE (s1262) ===

SHIPPED: docs/caching.md (~235 lines), a user-facing page covering all
seven CONTENTS items plus the FOURTH cache layer (#1200's string-eval
disk cache) that shipped between this task's filing and its execution
(per the s475 launch note, which superseded the original brief's item 3
description).  README already linked the page (an earlier session);
docs/STATUS.md gained a new link in its 'Compile happens at run start'
sharp edge.

Section-by-section:
 1. The saved core: content-keyed cache under ~/.pcl-cache/core/, vs the
    installed <prefix>/lib/pcl/pcl.core (#1302, built at install time).
 2. The module cache: three files per entry under modules/ (ir-spec
    9.2b); validity = the #1261 .deps content manifest -- CONFIRMED BY
    HAND (edited a dependency B2.pm without touching a dependent A3.pm;
    A3's answer changed on the next run, matching perl, A3.pm's own
    mtime unmoved); compile policy = PCL_COMPILE_DIRS/PCL_NO_COMPILE_DIRS
    (s471); cache dir = PCL_CACHE_DIR, a process fact (#1303); prune =
    last-use/30-day (#682, s470by); the 0700 refusal's exact text quoted
    from %p-check-cache-dir.
 3. String eval: the NEW disk cache (#1200, s473p, evals/) -- found and
    filed the gap that pcl --cache-info never lists evals/ (task #1335).
 4. The three checked-in artifacts (pack/mro/warnings): confirmed via
    p-load-extension that they are NOT cached at all -- plain `load` of
    the .lisp source every run; open as #1202.
 5. A dated measured-numbers table from s470bn/s470bp/s470bw/s473p,
    showing the three module-load fixes stacking (JSON::PP cold 13.4s
    pre-#1188 -> 1.43s warm with fasl caching -> 0.41s with the eval
    disk cache on top).
 6. Env-var + flag tables mirroring plan-cache-and-install-s471.md 1.1
    plus the four commands and the PCL_NO_FASL_CACHE alias.
 7. Multi-user/worktree/CI notes incl. the open #1119 caveat (module
    cache keyed on a hand-maintained generation string, not content) and
    the s470bz-filed #1327 caveat (a saved core memoises its builder's
    ASDF cache dir), one sentence each.

THREE PROBES run on main and pasted into scratch/s1262/STOP.md: pcl
--cache-info (confirms the evals/ omission); PCL_CACHE_DIR=<tmp> pcl -e
'use Text::ParseWords; print 1' then ls <tmp>/modules (two entries,
.deps manifests matching ir-spec 9.2b exactly); the
Pl/t/module-fasl-cache-01.t dependency-edit shape reproduced by hand in
a fresh tempdir (8 TAG|1 -> 107 TAG|1 after dropping B2's prototype
without touching A3.pm).

FILED: #1335 (pcl --cache-info omits evals/).  #1336/#1337 (of the
1335-1337 range) left unused.  Records: docs/session-log.md 'Session
1262', docs/DECIDED.md 's1262'.  Docs-only commit, no generation bump,
no gate/sweep/board owed.
subject: DOCS FOR USERS (USER 2026-09-05): a user-facing page on PCL's caches -- the saved core, the module .lisp/FASL cache and its keys and staleness rules (a dependency change does not invalidate a dependent until #1261; a CPAN upgrade likewise; `pcl --clear-cache`), string eval's compiler, the extension load, the knobs -- `docs/caching.md` linked from README + STATUS, with dated measured numbers
